brief: Identify documents and deadlines to preserve for a fictional claim.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Claim Records"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Conserva evidencia del reclamo"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Guarde provas do pedido"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify documents and deadlines to preserve for a fictional claim.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Claims need relevant facts, records and dates; preserve what you submit and its confirmation.
instruction.misconception: A verbal report guarantees payment or removes documentary requirements and stated deadlines.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Check the claim instructions; preserve relevant evidence, deadlines, submitted copies and confirmation. Reporting alone does not guarantee coverage or payment.
The requested records document the actual loss and its cost.
The notice deadline differs from the later invoice deadline.
A saved copy and receipt document what was sent and when.
The official channel can clarify acceptable evidence and next steps.
Receipt confirms submission, not the final coverage decision.
The first deadline still applies while supporting receipts follow later.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Claims need relevant facts, records and dates; preserve what you submit and its confirmation.

pt-BR.line: Pedido precisa de fatos, comprovantes e datas sob termos reais; guarde cópia rastreável do que envia.

en-US.line: Check the claim instructions; preserve relevant evidence, deadlines, submitted copies and confirmation. Reporting alone does not guarantee coverage or payment.

en-US.prompt: Which record set meets these instructions?
en-US.scene: Fictional claim asks for event date, damage photos and repair invoice.
help: Match each requested item to the relevant evidence.

feedback.met: The requested records document the actual loss and its cost.
feedback.not_yet: Match each requested item to the relevant evidence.

es-MX.scene: Reclamo ficticio pide fecha del evento, fotos del daño y factura de reparación.
help: Relaciona cada elemento pedido con evidencia relevante.

feedback.met: Registros pedidos documentan pérdida real y su costo.
feedback.not_yet: Relaciona cada elemento pedido con evidencia relevante.

pt-BR.scene: Pedido fictício exige data do evento, fotos do dano e nota do reparo.
help: Ligue cada item pedido à prova relevante.

feedback.met: Registros pedidos documentam perda real e seu custo.
feedback.not_yet: Ligue cada item pedido à prova relevante.

en-US.scene: Fictional instructions: notify by May 8; invoices may follow by May 20.
help: Track each required action with its own stated date.

feedback.met: The notice deadline differs from the later invoice deadline.
feedback.not_yet: Track each required action with its own stated date.

es-MX.scene: Instrucciones ficticias: avisar antes o el 8 de mayo; facturas hasta 20 de mayo.
help: Registra cada acción requerida con su propia fecha.

feedback.met: Fecha de aviso difiere de fecha posterior de facturas.
feedback.not_yet: Registra cada acción requerida con su propia fecha.

pt-BR.scene: Instruções fictícias: avisar até 8 de maio; notas podem seguir até 20 de maio.
help: Registre cada ação exigida com sua própria data.

feedback.met: Data do aviso difere da data posterior das notas.
feedback.not_yet: Registre cada ação exigida com sua própria data.

en-US.scene: A claim was submitted through the official portal.
help: Preserve evidence of submission as well as evidence of loss.

feedback.met: A saved copy and receipt document what was sent and when.
feedback.not_yet: Preserve evidence of submission as well as evidence of loss.

es-MX.scene: Reclamo fue entregado por portal oficial.

options.label: Copia guardada y folio de recepción

feedback.not_yet: Guarde prova de envio além de prova da perda.

en-US.prompt: What should happen with an unclear requirement?

help: Raise the issue promptly and keep its written response.

feedback.met: The official channel can clarify acceptable evidence and next steps.
feedback.not_yet: Raise the issue promptly and keep its written response.
